text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as organizing data or answering customer questions. This saves time and reduces mistakes. There are also new productivity tools that help workers plan their day, write emails, or analyze information faster. However, AI does not replace people completely. In many jobs, humans and AI work together. For example, a doctor may use AI to check test results, but the doctor still makes the final decision. Because of these changes, some jobs may disappear, while new jobs will appear. Workers need to learn new skills to stay successful.
